AdaptiveObservability._comment: Issue 10.8 dogfood (Dev). One-time setup: (1) POST /api/admin/apps {"slug":"adaptive-observability-meta","name":"Adaptive Observability (meta)"} with X-Observability-Admin-Key; (2) POST /api/admin/apps/adaptive-observability-meta/environments/Development/keys {"key_type":"server_api"}; (3) paste the plaintext into ApiKey and flip Enabled to true. HostUrl points the SDK back at this API. Then GET /api/dev/throw and confirm a server-category error lands under the meta-app.

KeyVault._comment: Empty by default — Dev falls back to user secrets / this file. To exercise the KV path locally, set Uri to https://adaptivetoolskeyvault.vault.azure.net/ and `az login`.
